title: I visited the US National Helium Reserve
summary: Tom Scott visits the US National Helium Reserve in Amarillo, Texas, and explains why headlines that the world is running out of helium are misleading. He covers the Federal Helium Program and its planned privatization.
why: Cited to show that helium is not actually running out, and for background on the federal reserve.
